data.one_liner: Translates dart:ffi calls on the web to WebAssembly using dart:js.
data.what_it_does: Web_ffi allows developers to use a dart:ffi-compatible API on the web by translating calls through dart:js to a browser running WebAssembly compiled with emscripten. It introduces a Memory class to handle the memory model differences between native platforms and WebAssembly.
use_when: You need to run WebAssembly code compiled with emscripten on the web using a dart:ffi-like API.
You are sharing existing C/C++ or WebAssembly logic that expects an ffi-like interface in a web Flutter application.
avoid_when: You are targeting native platforms where standard dart:ffi is already available.
Your WebAssembly modules require full struct support or array extensions which are not yet implemented.
strengths: Provides a drop-in solution mimicking the dart:ffi API on the web.
Allows reuse of ffi-based patterns across web and native targets.
weaknesses: Currently only supports WebAssembly compiled with emscripten.
Lacks support for structs (except opaque structs) and pointer array extensions.
Has strict constraints on function return types and pointer nesting.
data.setup_notes: Requires emscripten compiler settings and initializing Memory using Memory.init() before use.
